voice.continueLine: Anchovies are a vegetable. Put in a coin and I will prove it.
voice.selectLine: Sporke. Two sporks, one shoelace. The possum called it a weapon. I call it lunch.
tauntLines: Two sporks. One string. Zero mercy.
I am the fast one. The possum timed me with a sundial.
Anchovies are a vegetable. Hold still while I explain.
voice.endingText: Sporke tied a third spork to the string. The possum said no. He did it anyway.

parodyMeta.bootlegOf: the fast, goofy member of a four-reptile sewer ninja team, who fights with two sporks tied together
parodyMeta.gag: Named after what the sensei found in a dumpster; his nunchaku are two plastic sporks on a shoelace, and he has never once hit himself with them, which he mentions a lot
tells: Wears a paper soda-jerk hat instead of any kind of mask, because the sensei dressed him in the dark
